content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00049, SRS_BSW_00351 The RTE Generator shall wrap each definition of the optional OsAlarmCallback function with the following Memory Mapping : 1 #define OS_START_SEC_<sadm> 2 #include "Os_MemMap.h" 3 4 <OsAlarmCallback definition> 5 6 #define OS_STOP_SEC_<sadm> 7 #include "Os_MemMap.h" where <sadm> is the shortName of the SwAddrMethod referenced by the OsMemo- ryMappingCodeLocationRef of the OsAlarmCallback .
